groups.activity: clear six objectives; Oraxia mini-boss at stage 5, then The Fragmented
groups.meta: 7.69% each part, ~31% for some part per run
groups.mode: check your rolled loadout before choosing difficulty
conditions: You play Warframes the whole way: a randomly assigned frame and weapons that reroll with the Duviri spiral, not the Drifter.
Every run also pays 16-20 Scuttler Husks (20-24 SP) and 10 Pathos Clamps (15 SP), the pity currencies.
bonuses: Steel Path pays 50% more husks and clamps plus Steel Essence, but only worth it if the spiral rolled gear you've actually built.
Wall-latching or Operator Void Mode gives total immunity during Oraxia's scuttler phases, where she vanishes for 30s between health bars while Scuttlers swarm.

disclosures.title: damage attenuation was fixed
disclosures.body: Update 40.0 (2025-10-15) reworked attenuation to scale with enemy max health and apply per-player; both bosses die quickly now. Any pre-October-2025 post calling Steel Path Isleweaver pointless is stale.

groups.activity: buy whatever's still missing from Acrithis
conditions: The exchange only appears in the Dormizone; talking to Acrithis in Duviri doesn't show it.
bonuses: A second, separately listed 120-husk set is available if you want one Oraxia to keep and one to feed Helminth.

groups.activity: solo Duviri Experience for the open-world materials
groups.meta: Isleweaver's map barely touches these nodes

rows.label: Temporal Dust
rows.note: Isleweaver only; accumulates while farming husks

conditions: Kovnik, Aggristone and Tasoma barely drop in Isleweaver; farm them in the regular Duviri Experience instead.
Your gathered resources are only saved up to your last earned decree; grab a chest or side objective before aborting, or you lose everything since the last one.
Argon Crystal decays; claim the Systems build promptly once started.
bonuses: Reroll decrees at a cave entrance until Bountiful Harvest (double plant resources), stack a Resource Booster, and take Riding Intrinsic rank 5 (Smooth Path) to see resource icons on the minimap while mounted; reported 8-16 Tasoma per plant versus a base 2-4.

disclosures.title: farm Tasoma solo
disclosures.body: Nodes are shared per instance: joining a run in progress often means the host already stripped every cave, and other players can force an Undercroft transition that deletes the ones you were heading toward.
